description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer erase/protection/reset checkpoint: safe Rust owns EL/ED plus selective DECSEL/DECSED bounds, DECSCA protection state, ED3 scrollback clearing and the deterministic RIS buffer/view/cursor/attribute reset surface.

entries.notes: Safe erase_scrollback reproduces ED 3: resolved viewport rows move to logical row zero from a stable snapshot, the viewport keeps its horizontal offset while moving to top zero, the cursor keeps its viewport-relative position, and all rows below the moved viewport clear with initial attributes.

Safe erase_line/erase_display cover Microsoft's complete 3 erase directions × EL/ED × normal/selective matrix. ED is vertically viewport-bounded but spans complete buffer rows; normal erasure uses standard-erase active attributes while DECSEL/DECSED skip protected cells and preserve each erased cell's existing attributes.

DECSCA is owned as ordered active-attribute state: default/0/2 select unprotected, 1 selects protected, and later parameters win; direct writes carry the resulting protection attribute into buffer cells.

Safe hard_reset owns every RIS observable asserted by Microsoft here: shallow or scrolled buffer content is cleared to default cells, viewport origin and cursor return to 0,0, circular row state resets, and active attributes return to TextAttribute defaults.
